details:
### Summary

MCP configuration changes could omit owner authorization. In affected versions, an authorized non-owner external-channel sender could use `/mcp set` or `/mcp unset` to persist Gateway MCP server configuration.

This advisory is scoped to mutating MCP chat commands. Installed and owner-configured MCP servers remain trusted integrations; the failed boundary is authorization to add, replace, or remove their process configuration.

### Impact

A non-owner sender could persist an attacker-selected stdio MCP command that executed with the OpenClaw process user's privileges when MCP configuration loaded. This could affect host confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

### Patched Versions

The first stable patched version is `2026.7.1`.

### Mitigations

upgrade to `openclaw@2026.7.1` or later. Before upgrading, disable MCP chat commands in external channels and inspect configured MCP servers for unexpected entries.
summary: MCP configuration changes could omit owner authorization
